title: Feature request: G5 - Report high-noise readings as raw instead of SGV
symptom: Entries uploaded to Nightscout do not take noise levels into account when using the Dexcom G5. The noise level is available locally, but the MongoDB entries all contain "noise": 1 and report BG values as SGV. This makes it impossible for loop systems to recognize unreliable BG data, potentially leading to dangerous insulin dosing.
cause: The xDrip Nightscout uploader does not translate the calculated noise values to the Nightscout noise scale, so all entries are reported with noise=1 and as SGV regardless of actual noise.
fix: jamorham added support to translate the calculated noise values within xDrip to match the Nightscout noise scale, encoding xDrip's NOISE_TRIGGER threshold as "2", NOISE_TOO_HIGH_FOR_PREDICT as "3", and NOISE_HIGH as "4", with "0" meaning unknown noise. This change was included in the Oct 4th xDrip Nightly.
evidence_quote: I plan to add support to translate the calculated noise values within xDrip to ones to match the Nightscout noise scale.
